project_context.summary: REA-assisted Screen Studio research with read-only Electron/Mach-O inspection, private native-project event counts, and complete video export validation.
project_context.audience: Developers and coding-agent operators studying macOS Electron/native recording workflows.
project_context.problem: A successful inspection or export-complete log alone does not prove native capture, valid media or working authorization.
project_context.differentiator: Explicit evidence levels plus reusable privacy-preserving inspection and full-decode validation tools.
project_context.goal: Help readers reproduce file inspections and validate their own licensed recording/export workflow.

evidence.text: REA-assisted Screen Studio research with read-only Electron/Mach-O inspection, private native-project event counts, and complete video export validation.

documented_examples.content:
git clone https://github.com/Royo-Qiao/screenstudio-rea-research.git
cd screenstudio-rea-research

# Reads declarations and hashes; does not launch or modify the app.
python3 scripts/inspect_app.py "/path/to/Screen Studio.app"

# Prints counts only; does not emit recorded keys, window titles or coordinates.
python3 scripts/project_stats.py "/path/to/Demo.screenstudio"

# Checks metadata, decodes every video/audio stream, and hashes the stable file.
python3 scripts/verify_export.py "/path/to/export.mp4"
